images.title: The village dairy counter
images.purpose: Give the whole chapter on one picture: a village dairy counter with five objects, one for each family of ideas, each drawn simply and countably, for the child to say one idea from each object.
images.composition: A title, then one long counter with 5 cards standing on it, read left to right: pouch crate (equal groups and order), packet tray (halving, doubling and splitting), place value board (tens, hundreds and carries), box (box and lines), ledger (estimate, check and word problems).
images.exact_structure: Plain white frame, 1456 by 816. At the top centre the title The village dairy counter (bold, 44 px, dark #1F2937, about y 60). Below it, one counter: a thin grey #6B7280 strip, 1416 px wide and 14 px high (x 20 to 1436) at y 640 to 654. Five cards stand on the counter, each a white rounded rectangle 266 px wide and 530 px high (y 110 to 640) with a thin dark #2B2B2B outline (3 px), left edges at x 20, 306, 592, 878 and 1164, so each card's bottom edge touches the counter. Every card has its title centred near the top (bold, 24 px, dark, about y 150), a drawing in the middle and a caption near the bottom (24 px, dark, about y 575). CARD 1, title Pouch crate: a crate drawn as a rounded rectangle outline 220 px by 190 px, thin dark, at x 43 to 263 and y 210 to 400, holding exactly 12 pouches in 3 rows by 4 columns. Each pouch is a rounded rectangle 40 px wide and 44 px high filled teal #0072B2 with a thin dark outline, 10 px apart, the block of pouches spanning x 58 to 248 and y 229 to 381. Caption in two lines: 3 × 4 = 12 and 4 × 3 = 12. CARD 2, title Packet tray: a tray drawn as a rounded rectangle outline 240 px by 170 px, thin dark, at x 319 to 559 and y 215 to 385, holding exactly 24 packets in 4 rows by 6 columns. Each packet is a square 30 px by 30 px filled amber #E69F00 with a thin dark outline, 6 px apart, the block spanning x 334 to 544 and y 231 to 369. One dashed grey #6B7280 vertical cut line at x 439, from y 205 to y 395, between the third and fourth columns. Caption: 4 × 6 = 8 × 3. CARD 3, title Place value board: a board of exactly 4 columns by 2 rows of cells, each cell 52 px wide and 70 px high with a thin dark outline, spanning x 621 to 829 and y 215 to 365 with a 10 px gap between the two rows (row 1 at y 215 to 285, row 2 at y 295 to 365). Row 1 has the digits 3 and 8 in its two right cells (the tens and ones), both cells teal #0072B2 with white digits (bold, 40 px); its two left cells are empty white. Row 2 has the digits 3, 8 and 0 in its three right cells: the 3 and the 8 cells are teal with white digits, the 0 cell is amber #E69F00 with a dark digit; its left cell is empty white. Caption: 38 × 10 = 380. CARD 4, title Box: a box of exactly 3 columns by 3 rows of cells, each cell 66 px by 66 px with a thin dark outline, spanning x 910 to 1108 and y 215 to 413. The top left cell is empty. The top row has 10 and 3 in the next two cells, and the left column has 10 and 2 in the next two cells (bold, 30 px, dark; these four head cells have a white fill). The four inner cells are filled reddish purple #CC79A7 and hold 100 (top left of the four), 30 (top right), 20 (bottom left) and 6 (bottom right) in white bold 30 px. Caption: 12 × 13 = 156. CARD 5, title Ledger: a ledger page drawn as a white rectangle 220 px wide and 230 px high with a thin dark outline, at x 1187 to 1407 and y 205 to 435, with a teal #0072B2 binding strip 14 px wide down its left edge (x 1187 to 1201). Inside are exactly 3 lines of text, left aligned at x 1210 (bold, 22 px, dark), at about y 255, 315 and 375: 20 × 40 = 800, then 24 × 35 = 840, then 840 + 120 = 960. Each line has a thin grey #6B7280 ruled line under it (x 1210 to 1392, 1.5 px, at y 270, 330 and 390). Caption: Plan, solve, check. In all there are 5 cards, 5 titles, 5 drawings and 5 captions. No other numbers and no other objects. Nothing else in the frame.
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame
a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number
more or fewer than 5 cards, or cards in a different order, or a pouch, packet, cell or line count that differs from 12, 24, 8, 4 and 3
any extra decoration such as cows, people, price tags or animals, or any number other than the listed labels
images.takeaway: Every family of ideas of the chapter on one counter: groups and order in the crate, halving and doubling in the tray, digits moving left on the board, the box and its four cells, and the ledger that plans, solves and checks.
images.description: A long village dairy counter with five cards on it: a crate of 12 pouches in 3 rows of 4, a tray of 24 packets cut in the middle, a place value board showing 38 times 10, a 2 by 2 box for 12 times 13, and a ledger with three lines of working.
images.context: Concept image for Chapter Revision: The Dairy Farm. It gathers the ideas of the figures in your maths book into one counter; every number on a card is a practice value of this plan and is true.
images.teaching_notes: Walk the counter in reading order and ask the child to say one idea at each card, then to find one card they would like to try again. Do not add numbers to the cards; the pictures are only reminders.

image_decisions.why: A dairy counter with one object for each family of ideas gives the revision a single picture to walk through.
